name: Colorado Energy Experts
old_description: Solar is only part of the equation. We design coordinated solar and storage systems that protect your home, manage rising energy costs, and support future expansion.
about:
Colorado Energy Experts operates from Denver, Colorado, serving homeowners across the Front Range. The company focuses on coordinated solar and storage systems designed to protect homes, manage rising energy costs, and support future expansion. Its founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides whole-home energy upgrades that integrate solar panels, battery storage, inverters, high-efficiency heat pumps, windows, and insulation. Rather than selling individual products, it uses an Energy Planning Engine to model solar sizing, storage strategy, and long-term savings, then sequences upgrades so each improvement works with the others. The process begins with a discovery conversation to assess current usage, future electric demand, backup goals, and home efficiency before any equipment is recommended.

Customers are primarily Colorado homeowners facing unpredictable electric bills, aging HVAC systems, or uneven temperatures. The company addresses concerns such as backup power sizing, cost control, and avoiding oversized solutions. Examples include homeowners seeking to reduce grid reliance, replace a furnace or air conditioner, or fix drafty rooms.

Colorado Energy Experts distinguishes itself by starting with a planning conversation instead of a product pitch, emphasizing clarity over sales pressure. It aims to help homeowners understand tradeoffs, assumptions, and the right sequence of upgrades before moving to quotes or installation.
